limitations: Boundary extraction covers unshadowed JSON/global coercions plus parse and validation method candidates.
Caller-selected source analysis leaves 1 inventoried files outside analysis scope. Inventory identity covers the complete artifact; relationships through unselected sources remain unknown.
Child-process extraction covers asynchronous node:child_process creation, literal argv/env/stdio options, exit/error listeners, and kill signals.
CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
Configuration extraction covers process.env, process.argv, node:fs reads, and direct logical defaults.
Event extraction covers EventEmitter-style literal registrations, removals, and dispatch candidates; dynamic names remain unknown.
Function fingerprints are static candidates; equal digests can remain ambiguous and do not prove behavioral equivalence.
Graph coverage is incomplete; unavailable facts remain explicit and must not be read as absence.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Local data flow does not claim control-flow-sensitive reaching definitions or arbitrary dynamic property resolution.
Promise ownership covers explicit unshadowed Promise construction, static factories, aggregation, chaining, and await syntax only.
Request extraction covers fetch, WebSocket, node:http/node:https construction, direct option fields, and exact local response consumers.
Resource extraction covers built-in filesystem/network acquisition and exact local close/destroy/end handles.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
The semantic graph contains static syntax observations and conservative relationship candidates; it does not claim runtime execution.
Timer extraction covers global or node:timers scheduling and exact local-handle cancellation.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.

observations.observation: La referencia conserva intención durable e identidad previa/temporal, comprueba destino y sincroniza el cambio de puntero. La reconciliación se trata de forma explícita.
La referencia distingue journal de preparación y asentamiento, custodia, recibos durables y estado retenido ante ACK incierto.
La referencia describe y compara identidad/contenido de launchers elegidos, sin equiparar un nombre de ruta a una versión verificada.

unknowns: No se ejecutó ni importó runtime de OpenClaw. Helpers de inmutabilidad, durabilidad, fs-safe, esquemas y lectores externos a estos tres módulos no quedan acreditados por esta partición.
La observación de primitivas de root en la referencia no se traslada a un daemon privilegiado de Jarvis.
jarvis_decisions: Versiones propias locales con app+Python bajo el mismo CURRENT, revisión de copia/perfil/esquemas y rollback al paquete anterior compatible; sin downgrade automático de datos.
PENDING durable bloquea replay tras incertidumbre. Inspección es lectora; un ACK incierto no se transforma en éxito ni en permiso nuevo.
Canal development explícito, Python/Codex externos y autenticidad completa no acreditada. No equivale a distribución autocontenida o notarizada.
unique_count_note: El puntero inmutable ya figuraba en un lote anterior; esta revisión contextual no cuenta como una nueva ruta única.
